title: Software Test Automation Engineer
description:
**What will you do:**



In this role you will:


* Validate that production deployments behave as intended and meet quality standards
* Ensure reliable execution of nightly integration, regression, and load tests
* Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites for new API integrations
* Collaborate closely with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to support frequent and successful production deployments
* Act as a quality champion for **Data Streams**, including:Automated monitoring of operational metrics
* Detection of pipeline errors and failures
* Proactive identification of system deficiencies


Review and improve testing mechanisms for **IoT integrations** (e.g., Tridium, BACnet)Identify bottlenecks in existing test strategies and recommend improvementsResearch and adopt industry best practices for testing **data\-streaming technologies**


**What you will bring:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Communication, Electrical, controls Engineering, or a related field
* **3\&\#43; years** of proven experience as a Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer
* Strong experience in:Test planning for **cloud\-native applications**
* Designing test cases including **functional, edge, and negative scenarios**


Solid understanding of different testing levels:


* Unit testing
* System testing
* Integration testing
* Load / performance testing
* Security testing


Hands\-on experience with **test automation using Python, Cypress**Exposure to **AWS or other cloud platforms**Experience with **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** tools (Terraform preferred)Strong communication skills with the ability to:


* Clearly articulate issues
* Raise quality risks proactively


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**


* End\-to\-end testing of IoT integrations, including messaging protocols like MQTT
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, including:Deployment strategies (e.g., canary deployments)
* CI/CD pipelines
* GitLab workflows


Understanding of microservices\-based architecturesFamiliarity with Building Management Systems (BMS)



We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

title: Senior QA  Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Company:**

Edgar Efile Solutions Pvt. Ltd is one of the prominent, energetic, and fastest growing companies in the industry.

The company was established in the year 2013 and playing a major role in providing financial reporting service like XBRL, Edgar and Typesetting services with 100% focus on quality within a strict timeline to US Clients.

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team and help us deliver high\-quality software products. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated and AI\-driven testing solutions to ensure the functionality, performance, scalability, and reliability of our web applications. You will also collaborate with software developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to identify and resolve defects, improve testing processes, implement best practices, and drive intelligent test automation initiatives. 

**Responsibilities** 

· Develop test cases, test plans, test scripts, test data sets, or test procedures 

based on business requirements. 

· Report results of automated tests to development teams so that defects can be addressed before production release.

· Conduct post release audits to ensure that software is functioning properly in 

production environment.

· Perform load and performance tests using tools like JMeter or LoadRunner to check how well the system works and ensure scalability under high\-demand conditions.

· Perform manual testing on applications to identify bugs or defects in features.

· Coordinate with development teams to ensure that new features are thoroughly tested before deployment.

· Documenting acceptance criteria in user stories and tasks. 

**Requirements** 

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field 5\+ years of experience in QA automation engineering.

· Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.

· Experience with automation tools and frameworks such as **Selenium,**

**Playwright \& Cucumber**.

·Experience with web and mobile testing technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, or JSON. 

· Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, or Mercurial is desirable.

· Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins is plus.

· Experience with agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

· Excellent presentation, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, with a strong attention to detail, quality, and accuracy is essential.

· Experience with AI\-driven testing methodologies and tools, including intelligent test automation, **automated test case generation**, self\-healing test scripts, defect prediction, **smart regression testing**, and AI\-based test analytics, is an added advantage.

Job Type: Full\-time

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
